notes: In לִבְנֵי הָאָדָם the article on the rectum takes the phrase's written 'the', which English fronts because the rectum is rendered anarthrously ('of men'), under rule 29.

No article morpheme stands in the second chain, so both written 'the's there are supplied determiners, one on the outer construct and one on the inner, which rule 29 allows for a multi-level chain; the innermost rectum carries 'his' and needs none.
'mighty acts' heads on 'mighty' under rule 31, as at PSA.145.4.
